words.zh: 人造的；仿造的；虚伪的；非原产地的；武断的

words.ex_en: Talking about crime in the abstract just isn’t enough.
words.ex_zh: 抽象地谈论犯罪根本不足以说明问题。

words.zh: 乐意地， 欣然地； 容易地； 很快地， 立即
words.ex_en: Boats are readily available to visitors.
words.ex_zh: 游客可以很方便地租到船只。

words.ex_en: They agreed to co-operate with Brazil on a programme to protect the rain forests.
words.ex_zh: 他们同意和巴西合作进行一个保护热带雨林的项目。

words.ex_en: I’ll be asleep as soon as my head hits the pillow.
words.ex_zh: 我头一碰到枕头就会睡着。

words.ex_en: Sally keeps her make-up kit in her bag.
words.ex_zh: 萨莉把化妆包放在手提包里。

words.zh: [电子] 电路，回路；巡回；一圈；环道
words.ex_en: We did a circuit of the old city.
words.ex_zh: 我们绕着老城走了一圈。

words.ex_en: There is no heating available due to fuel shortages.
words.ex_zh: 因为燃料短缺，所以没有供暖。

words.zh: 扫描；浏览；细看；详细调查；标出格律
words.ex_en: He scanned the horizon, but there was no sign of the ship.
words.ex_zh: 他朝地平线处仔细眺望，但是找不到那艘船的踪影。

words.ex_en: I’m always working under pressure to meet deadlines (= finish something on time ) .
words.ex_zh: 我总是在赶工期的压力下工作。

words.ex_en: Carole was left to bring up the rear.
Can you guess what the extra processing is here?
words.ex_zh: 您可以猜出这里的额外处理是什么吗？

words.zh: 承担，保证；从事；同意；试图
words.ex_en: He undertook to pay the money back in six months.
words.ex_zh: 他保证在六个月之内还钱。

words.zh: 口头的； 用言辞的， 用文字的； 动词的
